title: Alexia's Extra Advancements
body:
This adds many new advancements to the game, including some old achievements, such as The Lie, and some all-new progression and miscelanious advancements, such as for getting a diamond pickaxe. 

This also adds a whole new advancement tab for many that have to do with collecting every block and item in every dyeable colour, such as stained glass, wool, and bundles(excluding leather armor).
